preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, k is between 0 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, k in test_cases) <= 2 * 10**6
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == '-1' or (len(stdout[i].split()) == n and all(int(x) in range(1, n+1) for x in stdout[i].split()) and len(set(stdout[i].split())) == n and sum(int(x) == j+1 for j, x in enumerate(stdout[i].split())) == k) for i, (n, k) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' if no valid permutation exists, or a permutation of numbers from 1 to n with exactly k fixed points.
